assets.name: app-icon
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate a new ZenxPOS Android Play Store app icon, exactly 512x512 pixels. Full bleed opaque square navy #123B65 background, no rounded exterior corners or external shadows. Center a striking custom cyan #46C4E8 and white geometric X emblem subtly combining two diagonal barcode ribbons and a receipt check. Inspired by the existing ZenxPOS navy wordmark with a tall cyan X, but optimize for tiny launcher sizes: bold clean silhouette, minimal details, high contrast, generous 18 percent padding. No words, no letters except emblem-like X, no gradients, no badges, no device mockup. Crisp premium brand mark.
